cards.explanation: The answer is two demon-possessed men. Matthew 8:28 says Jesus "…was met by two demon-possessed men coming from the tombs." Two of them, friends, and not one is holding a welcome sign.

The answer is the tombs. Matthew 8:28 says the two men came "…from the tombs." That's a place with burial graves, and nobody goes there for a picnic. When somebody walks out of there toward you, you notice.

The word is violent, friends. Matthew 8:28 says they were "…so violent that no one could pass that way." Think of a road that everybody just agrees to skip. When the whole route gets cancelled because of two men, that's serious.

The answer is True, and that's the surprise. The two men shout, "What do You want with us, Son of God?" (Matthew 8:29). They call Jesus the Son of God to His face. I'd say they knew exactly who He was.

The answer is that they ask if He came to torture them before the appointed time. They shout, "Have You come here to torture us before the appointed time?" (Matthew 8:29). The text doesn't say what the appointed time is, so I'll leave that one alone too. What I can say is that they were asking Jesus a question, and they shouted it.

The answer is False. There's no long speech. After the demons ask to be sent into the pigs, Jesus says one word: "Go!" (Matthew 8:32). One word, friends. I wish I could be that short when somebody asks me where I put the sprinkles.

The answer is down the steep bank and into the sea. Matthew 8:32 says "…the whole herd rushed down the steep bank into the sea and died in the waters." Notice that it says the whole herd, friends. Not one pig hung back to check the weather.

The answer is False. The text says those tending the pigs reported "…all this, including the account of the demon-possessed men." (Matthew 8:33). So the herd was only part of the news. I think that was a lot to say in one breath after running into town.

The word is leave, friends. Matthew 8:34 says that when they saw Him, "…they begged Him to leave their region." The whole town came out, and that was their request. The text doesn't tell us why, so I'll stay out of their heads.
